judgementFindings.detail: Repeated lock/stage/manifest/verify/rename/cleanup transactions have divergent cleanup; a shared transaction boundary could prevent divergence. This is a heuristic, not a documented violation.

findings.title: Retain active native captures until their previews release ownership
findings.requirement: docs/composition-media.md:137 and141-143 preserve last valid preview through failed readiness and cancel stale candidates.
findings.trigger: An active edited CLI preview retains its program lease while two later native preparations fail or are superseded in browser readiness; registered Lab previews also share an unrelated global FIFO of4 captures.
findings.consequence: The still-active preview loses its captured native URL and its next uncached seek returns404.
findings.reproduction: Real synthetic sequence and HMR program lease:3 preparations under one retained lease; first native frame URL returns404, latest returns200.
findings.recommendedRepair: Tie each active/candidate capture to explicit preview ownership; evict only unowned captures.
findings.status: open; reported by review, not changed in conflict repair
